newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: US report on looted Nazi gold 1600 GMT Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: US report on looted Nazi gold 1600 GMT Wednesday.

text.p: A long-awaited U.S. report on Nazi gold stolen by Nazi Germany in World War Two will be released on Wednesday at noon (1600 GMT) in Washington, the U.S. Embassy in Switzerland said.

The report, which is expected to level harsh criticism at Swiss dealings with gold looted from victims of the Holocaust, will be available via the Internet, either via the State Department's homepage or the Bern Embassy's homepage.
A news conference is also expected to be held in Washington to announce the report.
Hard copies of the report, which involved the work of 15 U.S. government agencies and drew on more than 15 million documents, will not be available, the embassy added.
The report is titled "U.S. and Allied Efforts To Recover and Restore Gold and Other Assets Stolen or Hidden by Germany During World War II: Preliminary Study."
The report can be accessed through the internet at either http://www.state.gov or www.state.gov/www./regions/eur/europe_home.html.
In Switzerland it can be accessed at: http://www3.itu.ch/EMBASSY/US-embassy.
